extension.summary: Rate media 1-10 after playback and send it to Jellyfin
extension.description: After a movie or episode finishes playing, JellyRate pops up 1-10 stars so you can rate what you just watched. The score is written back to your Jellyfin server as a per-user rating, reusing the login already stored by the Jellyfin for Kodi add-on (plugin.video.jellyfin). Open the add-on to browse your recently played items and re-rate any of them. No extra configuration required if Jellyfin for Kodi is signed in.
